claims.text: Substantial improvements over previously reported results were achieved, with at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet outperformed BERT and RoBERTa in negation detection and scope resolution, reporting state-of-the-art results with increases of 3.16 F1 points on the BioScope Full Papers.
